help:
VERBS

  LOOK                      the room
  EXAMINE <thing>  (X)      look at it. Looking twice is not the same as looking once.
  TAKE <thing>              some things can be carried
  FILE <clue>               file to the cogitator. Indexed, actionable, and reachable.
  NOTE <clue>               write it in your own notebook. Inert, useless, and yours.
  CLUES                     what you hold, and where you are holding it
  READ ROOM                 when you have enough of it
  DECODE                    when you have the key and the room it was cut for
  QUERY <code>              Lexicanum Vault, by shelf-address
  NOTES                     your case-notes, as the cogitator has them
  NOTEBOOK                  your notebook, as you wrote it

  GO <place>                elsewhere. The clock does not stop for the lift.
  ASK <person> ABOUT <x>    nothing is listed. Name it.
  SHOW <clue> TO <person>   put it in front of them and watch
  DETAIN / PROMISE / DEFY   some verbs belong to the person, not the terminal

  WAIT                      time passes either way
  SAVE / LOAD               suspend the session, or take it back up
  QUIT

Clue IDs look like A1, A3. FILE A1. NOTE A3. Most clues answer to a plain
word as well.
no_such_thing: There is nothing here by that name, and you have looked.
already_read: You have read it. Reading it a third time is not investigation, it is standing in a dead man's room refusing to leave.
no_such_exit: You cannot get there from here, or not in the time you have.
no_such_topic: You would have to know what you were asking for.
body_removed_elsewhere:
Somewhere above you, at the eighth minute, the medicae take him.

You are not there. Nobody sends word, because nobody has been told to, and the first you will know of it is the empty floor.
read_room_locked:
You do not have enough of this room to read it.

Signs are facts about the place you found them in. Whatever you are carrying, you did not find it here.
read_room_prompt:
You stop moving and let the room assemble itself.

READ ROOM FORWARD  — take the signs in the order he set them down
READ ROOM BACKWARD — take them the other way
no_terminal:
There is no cogitator here.

You have an authority-key in your coat that opens every terminal in the Adamant Crown, and the nearest one is a lift ride away, and that is the whole of the difference between having authority and being able to use it.
no_one_here: There is nobody here to ask.
not_here: There is nobody here by that name.
not_talking: They are here. They are not taking questions, and this is not the moment to make them.
precis:
CASE PRÉCIS :: VOSK, H., INQUISITOR :: DECEASED
COMPOSED BY COGITATOR FROM CASE-NOTES. FOR COUNTERSIGNATURE.

  1. The deceased was found in his private chambers, sealed from within, at
     the twenty-third hour and fifty-five. A Crown finding of self-termination
     was struck and countersigned. Medicae examination identified no toxin, no
     coercion residue and no psychic trace, and no wound other than that
     inflicted by the deceased's own weapon.

  2. The scene was examined by the investigating officer and found consistent
     with the finding. Effects were inventoried. No indication of third-party
     access was identified; the aperture log records a single entry in eleven
     hours.

  3. The Choir-vessel TALM, V. I. is cleared of transcribing any material
     dispatch to the deceased in the relevant period, no such dispatch being
     on record.

  4. The investigating officer requisitioned one Vault shelf in error
     (sanitation requisition ledgers, Munitorum liaison) and closed the
     requisition without action.

FINDING: SELF-TERMINATION. NO FURTHER ACTION RECOMMENDED.

Four paragraphs. You read them twice.

Every sentence is true. Every sentence is true in the way a man is honest
about the parts of a story he has been left holding, and there is not one word
in it you could point at and call a lie, and it describes a day you did not
have.
precis_prompt: [ SIGN it   ·   ANNOTATE it from your notebook   ·   REFUSE ]
precis_waiting:
The précis is on the terminal and the Crown is waiting for it.

You can read your own notes while it waits. You cannot put it down.
precis_nothing_to_add:
You go to annotate it, and open your notebook to do it from, and it is blank.

You have filed everything. It was the faster way and it was the way the terminal offered and there was a body on a timer.

There is nothing in your own hand to set against four paragraphs of the archive's, and an annotation that says *I remember it differently* is not an annotation, it is a note about your state of mind, and you know exactly what an Ordo conclave does with one of those.

[ SIGN it, or REFUSE ]
precis_signed:
You countersign it.

It is accurate, it is complete, it is what the record says, and refusing to sign a true document on the strength of a feeling is not a thing an Inquisitor of one day's standing does.

The cogitator files it inside four seconds and returns to its rest cycle.

For the next eleven days every clerk in the Adamant Crown will be helpful to you, because you are an officer whose first case closed cleanly and on time, and that will be worth a great deal, and you will not once be able to work out what it cost.

[ PRECIS_SIGNED ]
precis_annotated:
You annotate it.

Not an objection — an annotation, appended, in the field the form provides for one, transcribed by hand from a notebook nobody has asked to see. The number. The transit authority. The forty-one seconds. Whatever else is in your coat.

You sign under the annotation, which means you have signed a document that disagrees with itself, which is the only honest object anybody has produced today.

The cogitator files it without comment. It has a field for this.

Somewhere in the Administratum, inside a fortnight, a file will be opened on your judgement. It will be scrupulously fair. In eleven months a woman on a world that the record says was never colonised will read your annotation out loud, because it will be the only contemporaneous account of this day that anybody wrote by hand.

[ PRECIS_ANNOTATED — VERITY +1, CRASE_STANDING -1 ]
precis_refused:
You refuse to sign.

The cogitator asks, reasonably, for a ground of objection, and offers you eleven of them from a list, and not one of them is *the record is wrong about what I did*, because that is not a ground, it is a symptom.

You leave the field empty and refuse anyway.

The Crown will treat this as it treats everything: as a form that has not been completed. Act II will open with a formal competency query, courteously worded, with your name on it.

Interrogator Dmetri Vaux will hear about it before the end of the day, and will not say anything to anybody, and will revise something.

[ PRECIS_REFUSED — VERITY +1, CRASE_STANDING -2 ]
lyle_null:
LEXICANUM VAULT :: PERSONNEL / ADMINISTRATUM VARDAN
QUERY: LYLE, CASMIR — ORDINATE — SEAT 411
RETURNING 0 RECORDS.

NO ORDINATE OF THAT NAME IS OR HAS BEEN OF RECORD.
SEAT 411 IS NOT AND HAS NOT BEEN AN ADMINISTRATUM VARDAN SEAT.

You read it twice. It is not that he has left the service, or died, or been
struck. There is no seat. There has never been a seat 411, and a man who does
not exist signed an instrument that removed forty thousand people from the
register nineteen years ago, and the instrument is in your hand and it is
vellum and it is real.

The query goes into the log, the way every query does.
lyle_confirmation:
A courtesy note arrives.

LEXICANUM VAULT :: CORRESPONDENCE
RE: YOUR QUERY, LYLE, CASMIR — ORDINATE — SEAT 411

  This office confirms the nil return of your query of forty minutes past.
  No Ordinate of that name is or has been of record. Seat 411 is not and has
  not been an Administratum Vardan seat. We regret that we cannot assist
  further and remain at your disposal.

  CLERK-ORDINATE M. VESTIN, VAULT CORRESPONDENCE

Nobody confirms a nil return.

There is no procedure for it, no office that does it and no form it comes on.
A nil return is a nil return; it is the shortest and least interesting thing
an archive produces, and it is not followed up, and in eleven years of doing
this you have never once had one confirmed.

You look up Clerk-Ordinate M. Vestin, Vault Correspondence.

There is no Clerk-Ordinate M. Vestin.

[ B5 HELD ]
alms_routing:
LEXICANUM VAULT :: ECCLESIARCHY LIAISON / DISBURSEMENT ROUTING
QUERY: CATHEDRAL OF THE UNBLINKING EYE — ALMS ACCOUNT — ROUTING
RETURNING 1 RECORD.
--
ACCOUNT ......... ECCL/ALMS/VARDAN/UE
RELIEF .......... TITHE RELIEF APPLIED, 0.4% UNDER ASSESSED, CONTINUOUS FROM 786
FEED PREFIX ..... CN-∅ / PRIORITY-BLACK
COUNTERSIGN ..... (NONE REQUIRED — STANDING INSTRUMENT)
--
END OF RECORD. 1 OF 1.

Twenty minutes. A second-tier requisition, unmarked, on an account that is not
restricted, which anybody with your standing could have run on the first
morning.

A feed prefix you have never seen. A relief that has run continuously for
forty years. No countersignature required, because it is a standing instrument.

You do not know what CN-∅ is. You write it down anyway.

[ B10 HELD ]
crase_summons:
A runner finds you — not a vox, a Crown page with a folded slip, which you
notice, and which you would not have noticed a fortnight ago.

  *Come and see me when you have an hour. Nothing is wrong. — Y.C.*

She has been useful for a fortnight. A transport writ fixed in an afternoon
when the Munitorum said nine days. An informant flagged as unreliable before
you wasted a week. A note asking after Bez's cough, in her own hand, which she
did not have to send.

And on the eleventh night, at the third hour, an Arbites hold on tier two that
you were pulled out of by a Lord-Inquisitor who had been woken up and did not
mention it afterwards.
no_cipher: Whatever you are carrying, this is not the room it was made for.
decode_nothing: You have nothing on you that twenty-one glyphs could be read off.
decode_half:
You have half a key.

Half a key is not a slower key. It is a different object, and it reads nothing at all, and sitting with it longer will not change that.
cantica_null:
LEXICANUM VAULT :: ROUTING INDEX
QUERY: CANTICA-NULL / PRIORITY BLACK

  NO SUCH ROUTING ADDRESS.
  QUERY LOGGED.

Two lines. The second one is not an answer to anything; it is a note the
terminal has made about you, and it has never made one before.
cantica_confirm:
The terminal wakes up on its own.

LEXICANUM VAULT :: ROUTING INDEX

  CONFIRMED: NO SUCH ROUTING ADDRESS.

You did not ask it twice.

Nobody confirms a nil return. You have known that for eleven years and you
learned it again eleven weeks ago from a clerk who does not exist, and here it
is a second time, from an index, about an address a dead man cut into wax.

Something in this hive answers questions about Cantica-Null. It does not
answer them helpfully. It answers them *promptly*.
cantica_fenn:
From the next room, in the ordinary voice he uses for the ordinary parts of the day, Savant Aleth Fenn says:

"Kadmon Veil."

Then, after a moment, mildly: "I'm sorry — I don't know why I said that. Was it in something you were reading?"

He is entirely well. He is going to ask you twice more this week and be equally untroubled both times.
tass_delivery:
A Mechanicus apprentice you have met twice comes up four tiers with a felt case under his arm and waits at the door until you notice him.

"Magos Yttrix's compliments," Tass says. "He had the ash out of the censer off the Provost's inventory weeks ago and put it through the imager when the bench was quiet, and he'd have brought it himself but he's got the tier-four cogitators down."

He hands it over. A single imaging plate, twenty-one glyphs on it, in a hand that is older than anything either of you has a word for.

"Mind the edges, sir. They'll take a finger off and you won't feel it till after."

He does not look at the plate. He has no reason to; he does not read pre-Imperial and neither does his master, and it has been sitting in a rack on a workbench for eleven days being nothing at all.

There is no docket with it, and no imaging log, and no signature on the recovery, because nobody asked Magos Yttrix Cael to do this and so there is no record that he did.

[ B21 HELD ]
theta_manifest:
LEXICANUM VAULT :: EFFECTS HOLDING, STACK THETA
RETURN: VOSK, H. — INQUISITOR — DECEASED IN SERVICE

  CRATES: 7
  STATUS: HELD, UNCLAIMED
  COUNTERSIGN REQUIRED FOR ACCESS: YES (STANDING INSTRUMENT ON FILE)

  1  DESK PAD, ONE; STATIONERY, SUNDRY
  2  BOOKS, ELEVEN; CORRESPONDENCE, BUNDLE
  3  GAMING SET, INCOMPLETE
  4  VESTMENTS AND OUTER CLOTHING
  5  WRITING INSTRUMENT, MECHANICAL; SUNDRY OFFICE
  6  DEVOTIONAL ITEMS, SUNDRY
  7  UNSORTED

An ordinary, boring, entirely legitimate return. Nobody obstructs it and
nobody asks why you want it, and it takes eleven minutes.

You read it twice on the way back to your chair and then a third time sitting
down, because crate three says *incomplete* and you cannot think of a reason a
stock clerk would write that about a board with all its pieces on it.

There is no line for footwear.
vault_none:
LEXICANUM VAULT :: NO SUCH SHELF-ADDRESS IN THIS BLOCK.
CHECK QUERY.
press_what: PRESS what? Name the thing it said.
press_nothing: It has not said anything about that.
cite_amended:
You put it in front of it.

It reads the reference, confirms that the record is held, and restates it back to you, and what it restates is not what you remember writing.

It is not disagreeing with you. It has the document; you have a memory of the document; and the document is the authority, and you filed it yourself.
symptom_option:
There was a thing you said to Crase once and have been meaning to say again.

You go looking for the words and they are not the words. Not forgotten — you
have the shape of them, the length of them, the moment. What you do not have
is the sentence, and you have never in your life mislaid a sentence.
symptom_memory:
You look up something you requisitioned yourself, out of your own case-notes,
because you want to check a date against the manifest.

NO SUCH ENTRY.

It is the same three words the Vault uses for a shelf that was never filled,
in the same spacing, and there is no relay within nine days of this hull and
nothing aboard it has been edited by anybody.
symptom_note:
You open your notes to check something you wrote on the fourth day of all
this.

The sentence is there. It is one clause shorter than you remember, and you
cannot swear to that, and there is nobody within nine days to ask.
rhod_smuggles:
Port-Adept Alcuin Rhod puts something into your hand on the shuttle ramp and
walks away before you have got it into your coat.

Report 415. Cycle 44. Not the bound original — a copy, on scraped stock, in a
fourth-grade palimpsest hand, made at some point in the last nine hours by
somebody who is licensed to scrape a document of the second class and is not
licensed to do this.

*I record these not as complaint but as evidence, in the event that evidence is
what is wanted.*

He was not asked. He was not hinted at. He read every report in that room twice
before he was nineteen and he has decided, on his own, at a shuttle ramp, that
somebody ought to be able to prove it.

What is done to him for it happens after you lift and you are never told about
it, and the Marchioness does not tell you, and Rhod never mentions it in
thirty years.

[ C12 HELD ]
slips_follow:
You walk off the floor and it follows you.

The first slip is under the cabin door when you get there. The second arrives
about forty minutes later. They are numbered, they are in order, and they are
the rest of the session you did not stay for.

Nobody pushed them. There is a slip-printer at the end of a rank on a floor
where three thousand people have gone off shift, and it is printing everything
the store reads out, in order, as it has for a hundred and forty years, and
somebody on the night watch is walking them up because a slip is what you take
away.

By the fourth one you have stopped picking them up off the floor and started
waiting by the door.

*Unreconciled. No living family. No confidants. Will not stop. Reads well.*

*Acceptable for expenditure.*

[ C19 HELD ]
ending_b_inaction:
You have been on this station for a while now.

You could not say exactly how long, and the file would tell you if you asked
it, and you have not asked it.

At some point in the last few days somebody had a chair brought up from the
gallery, because you had been standing, and it seemed sensible. It is the fifth
chair. It is not worn anywhere.

You are sitting in it.

Kesh pours. Crase exhales for the first time in eleven weeks.

Your first correction is offered as a courtesy, and it is your own guilt,
because your own guilt is a contradiction and contradictions are what this room
resolves. Approval takes nine seconds.

You do not remember deciding.

The file is clean. You cannot remember what was wrong with it.
bez_remembers:
Bez says it in the middle of something else, the way you mention a thing you
both already know.

"After sub-level nine. After you carried me out — and don't tell me you didn't,
I was awake for most of it."

You have no record of it.

Not a gap, not a doubt, not a thing you half-remember: you have the whole of
that week in your own hand in your own notebook, day by day, and there is no
carrying anybody out of anything in it.

"Sergeant."

"Sir." She goes back to what she was doing. "I'll not make a thing of it. I know
you don't like it mentioned."

You have never said that to her.
sublevel_null:
LEXICANUM VAULT :: OPERATIONS INDEX
QUERY: SUB-LEVEL NINE — ADAMANT CROWN — OPERATIONAL

  NO SUCH OPERATION.

Three words, in the spacing the Vault uses for a shelf that was never filled,
which is the same spacing it uses for a shelf somebody emptied.

There is no sub-level nine in the Adamant Crown. There are eight. You have
counted them twice and you count them again that evening and there are eight,
and Sergeant Beskra Oduya has a scar on her forearm that you have seen forty
times and have never once asked about.
file_ilaria:
LEXICANUM VAULT :: PERSONNEL
TALM, VESSE ILARIA — ASTROPATH, SANCTIONED — CHOIR OF CANTOR

  Bound to the Choir at nine. Transit vessel, thirty-one years. Carriage
  grade four. Nine commendations, none contested.

  Attached to the Ordo Hereticus 0997.4.211 at the request of the
  investigating officer.

  NOTE, 0997.4.211: subject was the receiving vessel for dispatch
  0997.4-1188 (Vermilion, scrub-on-carry). Duration forty-one seconds.
  Subject countersigned a summary of the transmission which does not agree
  with the transmission. Subject reported this herself, in writing, within
  the hour, and has repeated the report at every subsequent muster. The
  Choir-Prefect has recorded no finding. Subject remains on light carriage
  pending one.

Eleven lines about a woman who told the truth about herself before anybody
asked her to.
file_ilaria_thin:
LEXICANUM VAULT :: PERSONNEL
TALM, VESSE ILARIA — ASTROPATH, SANCTIONED — CHOIR OF CANTOR

  Bound to the Choir at nine. Transit vessel, thirty-one years. Carriage
  grade four. Nine commendations, none contested.

  Attached to the Ordo Hereticus 0997.4.211 at the request of the
  investigating officer.

  Subject remains on light carriage.

It is a clean file. Every line in it is true, every reference resolves, and
nothing has been struck.

You read it twice looking for the paragraph about the forty-one seconds and
then stop, because you cannot now swear that you did not read it somewhere
else.
file_fenn:
LEXICANUM VAULT :: PERSONNEL
FENN, ALETH — SAVANT — LEXICANUM VARDAN

  Mnemonic augmetic, Hexta-pattern, fitted at nineteen. Sector holdings:
  tithe, census, shipping, ecclesiastical returns, 811 to present.

  Instrument note: the Hexta-pattern is un-networked by design. Subject
  holds what subject was given and is corrected only by hand, on
  requisition, with a countersignature.

  Four services on record. Last service 0997.2.19, Yttrix Cael, Magos.

That one word is why you brought him.
file_fenn_thin:
LEXICANUM VAULT :: PERSONNEL
FENN, ALETH — SAVANT — LEXICANUM VARDAN

  Mnemonic augmetic, Hexta-pattern, fitted at nineteen. Sector holdings:
  tithe, census, shipping, ecclesiastical returns, 811 to present.

  Instrument note: the Hexta-pattern holds what subject was given and is
  corrected on requisition, with a countersignature.

  Four services on record. Last service 0997.2.19, Yttrix Cael, Magos.

The instrument note is there. It is the same sentence, near enough, and it
says what it always said.

You go and look at your own notebook, where you wrote the word down on the
second day because it was the whole reason he mattered, and it is in your
hand, and it is not in the file, and there is nothing on the file to say it
ever was.
file_bez:
LEXICANUM VAULT :: PERSONNEL
ODUYA, BESKRA — SERGEANT — ORDO HERETICUS, ATTACHED

  Astra Militarum eleven years, Cadian 44th. Ordo attached 0815. Eleven
  years in the service of VOSK, H., Inquisitor, deceased.

  Two citations. One reprimand, 0818, insubordination, expunged on appeal
  by the officer she was insubordinate to.

  Medicae, 0997.4.211: fibrotic degeneration, advanced, occupational.
  Prognosis fourteen months. Subject not informed at own standing request
  recorded 0821.

  Literacy: not assessed.

The last line is two words and it has been on this file for eleven years, and
Hadrian Vosk read this file, and never once made her ask.
file_bez_thin:
LEXICANUM VAULT :: PERSONNEL
ODUYA, BESKRA — SERGEANT — ORDO HERETICUS, ATTACHED

  Astra Militarum eleven years, Cadian 44th. Ordo attached 0815. Eleven
  years in the service of VOSK, H., Inquisitor, deceased.

  Two citations. One reprimand, 0818, expunged on appeal.

  Medicae, 0997.4.211: fibrotic degeneration, advanced, occupational.
  Prognosis fourteen months.

It is shorter than you remember and everything in it is correct.

The last line is not on it. You know what the last line said and you know what
it cost her to have it be true and you cannot produce it, and if you raised it
with the Lexicanum they would ask you where you had read it.
rosette_record:
LEXICANUM VAULT :: PERSONNEL
INQ. ROSETTE 4471-K — ORDO HERETICUS

  {VAULTRECORD}

  Records-adept, Lexicanum Vardan, eleven years. Elevated 0997.4.211,
  Vardan Prime, on the instrument of CRASE, Y., Lord-Inquisitor.
  Requested by VOSK, H., Inquisitor, 0997.4.205.

  No dependants of record. No confidants of record.

It is spelled wrong.

One vowel, in the family name, and it has been wrong since you were nineteen
and put in a correction that was acknowledged and filed and did nothing. You
stopped raising it somewhere around the fourth requisition.

{VAULTRECORD}, it says, and has said for eleven years.

There is something obscurely reassuring about finding it wrong here too.
rosette_thin:
LEXICANUM VAULT :: PERSONNEL
INQ. ROSETTE 4471-K — ORDO HERETICUS

  {INITIAL}

  Records-adept, Lexicanum Vardan, eleven years. Elevated 0997.4.211,
  Vardan Prime, on the instrument of CRASE, Y., Lord-Inquisitor.
  Requested by VOSK, H., Inquisitor, 0997.4.205.

  No dependants of record. No confidants of record.

Your family name is on it.

Where {GIVEN} was there is an initial.

You have read four hundred personnel records and about a fifth of them carry
an initial, because a clerk abbreviated a long name once, or a form ran short
of field, or somebody in 811 decided that was the house style for that grade.
It is the most ordinary thing in the world.

You sit with it for a while and then you close the query, because there is
nobody you could raise it with who would not, quite reasonably, ask you to
spell the name you say is missing.
session_saved:
The session closes. The cogitator holds it the way it holds everything:
without comment, and until somebody asks for it back.
session_resumed:
The session opens where you left it.

The clock has not moved. Nothing has moved. Whatever was going to happen next
is still going to happen next.
checksum:
The terminal renders a query-checksum under the return. It always has. No
other grade of adept is issued a terminal that shows it and you have never in
eleven years met anybody who reads it.

You read it, because you were trained to, on a bench, at twenty-three.

The checksum under this return does not match the checksum in the session log
for the same query, forty minutes ago, in this session, on this terminal.

A return that has been re-rendered from an amended record checksums
differently. That is not an inference and it is not a feeling. It is two
numbers, both of which are on this screen, and either the Lexicanum Vault
issued a checksum implementation that is wrong, or the record changed between
the two renders.

You copy both numbers into your notebook by hand, in ink, with the time.

[ VERITY +2 ]
